'''House Kilvar''' is one of the known merchant [[House]]s of [[Arad Doman]]. They eventually moved to [[Ostin Falls]] on the border of [[Almoth Plain]] and [[Toman Head]], where they became the ruling mayoral family from c. {{ne|948}} onwards.

The head of the family is Mayor [[Bretton Kilvar]]. His son [[Lorwyn Kilvar|Lorwyn]] was arranged to marry [[Meka Antos]] of [[Bandar Eban]] in order to help the town's economic prospects in light of the declining trade from [[Toman Head]], Arad Doman, and [[Tarabon]], although Lorwyn did not want to be in an arranged marriage. He was eventually convinced to return to his family by the guards of House Antos.<ref>''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
